sentences.l2: 祖母の部屋を片付けていると、古い手紙の束が見つかった。
sentences.l1: When I was tidying up my grandmother's room, a bundle of old letters was found.

sentences.l2: それは、祖父が若い頃、遠い町で働いていた時に祖母へ送った書簡だった。
sentences.l1: They were letters that my grandfather had sent to my grandmother when he was young and working in a distant town.

sentences.l2: 電話もあまりなかった時代、二人は一週間に一度、手紙で気持ちを伝え合っていたという。
sentences.l1: In an era when there were not many telephones, they say the two conveyed their feelings to each other by letter once a week.

sentences.l2: 丁寧な字で書かれた言葉からは、相手を大事に思う気持ちが伝わってきた。
sentences.l1: From the words written in neat handwriting, feelings of cherishing the other person came across.

sentences.l2: 祖母は「手紙は、届くまで待つ時間も楽しかったのよ」と懐かしそうに話してくれた。
sentences.l1: My grandmother told me nostalgically, "With letters, the time spent waiting until they arrived was fun too."
